description: This file defines a mock class CloudStoreImplementationMock inheriting multiple interfaces related to storage operations. It uses Google Mock for method mocking, and includes interface headers for store, store2, store cache, inspector, and limit functionalities.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementationMock
classes.description: Mock class implementing multiple storage-related interfaces for unit testing

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks registration of a notification with the store

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Mocks setting a key-value pair in the store

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a value for a key from the store

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Mocks deletion of a specific key

methods.name: SetValue (IStore2)
methods.description: Mocks setting a scoped value with TTL

methods.name: GetValue (IStore2)
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a scoped value and TTL

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of keys within a scope

methods.name: GetNamespaces

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
